search_scope.coverage_reason: No frozen exhaustive literature universe or coverage certificate was available; this is a bounded primary-source search.

sources.title: Explicit Heegner Points: Kolyvagin's Conjecture and Non-trivial Elements in the Shafarevich-Tate Group
verified_claims: Kolyvagin's conjectural nontriviality/structure theorem implies that even nonzero analytic rank gives p-infinity Selmer Z_p-corank at least two.
The p-infinity Selmer corank dominates Mordell-Weil rank, with equality exactly when the p-primary Tate-Shafarevich group is finite.

sources.title: Kolyvagin's Conjecture, Bipartite Euler Systems, and Higher Congruences of Modular Forms
verified_claims: For a non-CM weight-two newform and compatible generalized Heegner/local/residual hypotheses, the paper proves nontriviality of a Kolyvagin class/system.
Under those hypotheses the Kolyvagin-system vanishing order controls Selmer eigenspace ranks.

sources.title: Selmer groups and the indivisibility of Heegner points
verified_claims: Proves p-indivisibility of derived Heegner points for certain primes p and elliptic curves over Q, giving proved cases of Kolyvagin's conjectural nonvanishing.

sources.title: Kolyvagin's conjecture for modular forms at non-ordinary primes
verified_claims: Extends versions of Kolyvagin's conjecture to non-ordinary primes using signed Selmer groups, but the route is built from a rank-one Selmer/converse input rather than a direct complex-rank-two second-derivative carrier.

sources.title: The refined Tamagawa number conjectures for GL_2
verified_claims: Provides a discrete Selmer-structure formula via Kolyvagin derivatives of L-values under a localized Iwasawa-main-conjecture input; it explicitly differs from complex or p-adic analytic variation and therefore is not the selected complex-second-derivative bridge.

sources.title: Plectic Heegner classes
verified_claims: Constructs plectic Heegner classes and links them to plectic/mock invariants; the abstract states expected higher-rank arithmetic control rather than a complex-second-derivative nonvanishing theorem.

sources.title: Anticyclotomic Iwasawa theory of CM elliptic curves at ramified primes
verified_claims: Proves an integral anticyclotomic Iwasawa main conjecture in a CM ramified-prime setting and interpolation/logarithm relations, but does not state the selected complex-second-derivative-to-root-faithful-object theorem.

negative_history_preserved: No source-wide nonexistence claim is made.
A p-adic derivative, higher-weight first derivative, discrete Kolyvagin derivative, or function-field higher derivative does not count as the complex-s second derivative.
Kolyvagin-system nontriviality can produce a Selmer-rank carrier without identifying L''(E,1) with that class; this is an alternate relation, not a target-cell success.
Selmer corank is not Mordell-Weil rank without a Sha finiteness/corank-zero bridge.
